evidence.text: The data contained a 97,786-patient cohort, including 16,865 DR cases (17.25%).
After a 64%/16%/20% training/validation/test split, SMOTE was applied only to the training subset, while validation and test sets retained the observed prevalence.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《A Robust and Trustable Approach to Incorporate Medical Domain Knowledge in Machine Learning Models for Diabetic Retinopathy Screening Using Routine Lab Results》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-7】On the untouched test set (n = 19,558), the eight-feature XGBoost model achieved 95.35% accuracy, 91.17% sensitivity, 96.22% specificity, an F1-score of 87.12%, AUROC of 97.24%, and AUPRC of 94.55%.

evidence.text: On the untouched test set (n = 19,558), the eight-feature XGBoost model achieved 95.35% accuracy, 91.17% sensitivity, 96.22% specificity, an F1-score of 87.12%, AUROC of 97.24%, and AUPRC of 94.55%.
